appSubtitle: Two domains, one idea: a plan is a path through a space of states.
statsTitle: What each search had to do
bfsHint: Fewest steps. Ignores what a cell costs.
dijkstraHint: Cheapest path. Ignores where the goal is.
greedyHint: Runs at the goal. No guarantee at all.
astarHint: Cheapest path, guided by the estimate.
noPath: There is no path at all — the goal is walled off.
pathBlocked: An obstacle landed on the path. Replanning…
scoreValid: Your path costs {cost}; the optimum is {optimal}.
scorePerfect: Your path costs {cost} — that is the optimum. Well done.
scoreInvalidEndpoints: A path has to start at the robot and end at the goal.
scoreInvalidWall: That path goes through a wall.
scoreInvalidJump: That path jumps — every step must go to a neighbouring cell.
scoreInvalidEmpty: Draw a path first, by dragging from the robot to the goal.
drawHint: Drag from the robot to the goal to draw your own path, then score it.
preLabel: Preconditions — all of these had to be true
beforePlan: Press Plan to see how the planner gets there.
planFound: Found a {n}-action plan after looking at {expanded} states.
footerNote: Every number on this page was computed live by the planner — nothing is pre-recorded.
